description: Ministry of Power and Energy  - Order to acquire the lands in Marawanpulavu, Chavakachcheri D/S Division, Jaffana District for the Ceylon Electricity  Board
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition. It contains an order by the Minister approving the acquisition of specific parcels of land for the Ceylon Electricity Board, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, coordinates, and current claimants. While a government minister is named, the core subject matter is land/property acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
